manifest.name: mlp-q4k-skip-layer0
manifest.description: Every MLP block as Q4_K except layer 0, which selects the batched-prefill path. V6 (all 64 blocks) saves 1.2 GiB but pays for it in prompt reading; if layer 0 is what chooses the slow path, leaving it NVFP4 should keep most of the memory saving at a fraction of the prefill cost.

execution.packed_wide: NVFP4 if free VRAM at load > payload + 3 GiB, else Q4_K(nvfp4)
